projects.title: Mc Dinero - iOS / Android / WindowsPhone 8
projects.description:
Game for mobile platforms iOS/Android and Windows phone. It was developed with Cocos2dx cross-platform in C++

I made over 750,000 downloads with this game in all platforms. It was an amazing experience for me. I'd like to develop other games and try to do my best when I do.

projects.title: TodoPlan Free - iOS
projects.description: As every mobile developer I wanted to have at least one application at the Apple Store, so I decided to develop this TodoList. You use it to write the things you have to complete and put and alarm to each one. Simple.
